Inspect whether any test was weakened without equivalent stronger behavioral coverage. Run only the listed focused tests and smoke command. Do not edit, format, commit, or generate files in the workspace. Return a single gate of APPROVE or REPAIR; REPAIR must list exact blocking lines/behaviors and a focused remediation, not a redesign.
